'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female student found at night nearby the {{Rubi|Solis Lens Array|Lahai-Roi Resonance Nexus}} making fun of her classmate, '''Coywood'''.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Helmi:''' If it earns me a solid paper, I'm fine to be a [[Hoochief]]!{{sic}}

==Dialogue==
:'''Helmi:''' Zahira was literally stunned. Don't tell me you didn't feel anything?
:'''Coywood:''' Huh? I... just got a small sample from her, that's all.
:'''Helmi:''' Oh please... When you got that component, you were hopping around like a Hoochief, waving it around, your eyes practically glowing.
:'''Helmi:''' You were yelling, "YES! YES! My chain of evidence is  complete! Ghu ghu gaga—!"
:'''Coywood:''' I—I wasn't that dramatic... And even if I was, what about it?!
:'''Coywood:''' If it earns me a solid paper, I'm fine to be a Hoochief!
{{Dialogue End}}
